name: CosmoKick.io
storyline:
Football has gone interstellar.

CosmoKick is a physics-based multiplayer football game where jetpack-powered players compete in futuristic space arenas. Fly, tackle, pass, and score spectacular goals using skillful movement and momentum-based gameplay. Play instantly in your browser and experience football like never before: fast, chaotic, and set among the stars.
summary: CosmoKick.io is a free to play, multiplayer 3D football game. Developed by an indie game dev over the last 3 years.
